privacyDisclosurePending: Privacy disclosure required before page access
privacyDisclosureTitle: Before Manga Translator reads this page
privacyDisclosureBody: When you activate translation, the extension reads comic images and the current-page origin so it can detect, process, and replace translated images.
privacyDisclosureData: Data handled locally can include the current-page origin, image bytes or screenshot crops, OCR text, translated text, and generated result/cache data.
privacyDisclosureLocalOnly: This consent covers processing between Chrome and the Local Engine on this computer. It does not authorize sending image or text data to an external provider.
privacyDisclosureRetention: Local result cache can be cleared in Settings. Completed Local Engine job files are automatically cleaned after at most 24 hours.
privacyDisclosureNoAds: The extension does not use this data for advertising, profiling, or unrelated analytics. External telemetry is disabled by default.
privacyConsentButton: I agree — activate on this page
remotePrivacyDisclosurePending: Separate consent is required for external text translation
remotePrivacyDisclosureTitle: Before extracted text leaves this device
remotePrivacyDisclosureBody: The selected profile sends extracted dialogue and narration text to $1 over HTTPS so it can be translated into Arabic.
remotePrivacyDisclosureData: Only OCR text classified locally as dialogue or narration is eligible for this external translation request.
remotePrivacyDisclosureLocalImages: Comic images, screenshot pixels, masks, and visual context remain on this device.
remotePrivacyDisclosureSfx: Sound effects and uncertain text are filtered locally and are not sent to the translation provider.
remotePrivacyDisclosureBinding: This consent is bound to this exact profile fingerprint, provider list, privacy descriptor, and disclosure version; a change requires consent again.
